comparison.objective: Fit a parallel link onto the correct pin branch so a desktop arm's wrist plate remains level.
comparison.physical_skill: Mechanism-aware alignment and intact link-on-pin assembly, versus coaxial mandrel insertion followed by controlled impact fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Link is on the red pin, wrist plate is level, and the robot releases it; numeric seating/level tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: This is the closest assembly-style record, but it tests closure-branch selection and retained-link insertion, not irreversible tang removal, preservation of a coil, and recovery of free fragments.
